Sun.summary: To Build · President / executive branch. The actual head of government and supreme authority; its condition and relationships describe how executive power is operating. Combustion shows another actor being drawn into the executive's purposes.
Sun.mundane: The actual head of government — whoever really calls the shots in the executive branch, not the national 'ego.' The Sun's dignity and aspects tell you plainly how the government will fare. Watch combustion: any planet within 8°30' is co-opted by the executive, used for the government's ends rather than its own.

Moon.actor: the political class and public mood
Moon.summary: To Nourish · Political class and public mood. The voiced layer of the nation; compare the Moon with the 1st-house ruler — the ordinary populace — to see whether political voice and national body remain aligned.
Moon.mundane: The political class and public mood — the voiced layer of the nation. 'People (Moon)' is also sanctioned in Katie's usage, but compare the Moon with the 1st house and its ruler, the ordinary populace. When Moon and 1st-ruler are in harmony, political voice and national body remain aligned; a run of hostile aspects warns that they have separated.

Mercury.actor: the press and the national conversation
Mercury.summary: Communication · Press and national conversation. Media, transport, trade, and treaties-as-documents; its condition shows whether information and movement carry cleanly or become confused, dysfunctional, or interrupted.
Mercury.mundane: The national conversation: press, media, transport, trade documents, treaties-as-paper, the chattering classes. Strong Mercury = ideas drive events. Afflicted Mercury = the ideas on center stage are confused or dysfunctional, and communication and transport break down. Never far from the Sun — the intellectuals usually serve the established order.

Venus.summary: To Magnetize · Women, arts, diplomacy, social harmony, and currency. What the nation values, attracts, reconciles, and gives beautiful form; condition distinguishes peace and prosperity from scandal, extravagance, exclusion, or public ugliness.
Venus.mundane: The women of the nation — the women's vote, women's issues — plus the arts, culture, diplomacy, social peace, and the currency's grace. Dignified: contentment and prosperity. Debilitated: scandal, extravagance, women's concerns shoved aside, ugliness in public life.

Mars.actor: the military, the men of the nation
Mars.summary: To Energize · Military, conflict, and the men of the nation. War, force, aggression, unrest, and the national capacity to act; angular Mars heightens the warning, while a well-conditioned Mars can force reform and remove bad officials.
Mars.mundane: The military, war, violent crime, political unrest — and the men of the nation, the men's vote. Mars ANGULAR (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) is the classic war warning; Mars in the 7th under any condition can presage war. Well dignified, he turns reformer: bad officials removed, real prosecutions, hard changes for the better.

Jupiter.summary: To Expand & Affirm · Corporations, courts, and growing hierarchies. Law, religion, wealth, and alliances; an economic barometer whose expansion can produce peace, order, and profit — or excess, avoidance, stagnation, and corruption.
Jupiter.mundane: Every hierarchy that grows — corporations above all, plus courts, judges, clergy, charities. The economic barometer: watch Jupiter for the nation's material condition. Dignified: peace, order, profit. Poorly placed: stagnation and corruption — problems ignored while they are still small enough to manage.

Saturn.summary: To Endure · Establishment and bureaucracy. Structure, authority, restriction, and institutional inertia; well-conditioned Saturn stabilizes through discipline and wise management, while an impaired Saturn brings accumulated consequences home.
Saturn.mundane: Hard facts, hard knocks, and the things that endure: the establishment, the bureaucracy, institutional inertia. Dignified: stability and calm — prosperity through wise management, not growth. Debilitated: the unwanted consequences of past behavior arrive; negative Saturn brings more grief than almost anything else in a mundane chart.

Uranus.summary: To Awaken · Individuals, technology, and counterculture. Revolution, disruption, automation, and sudden reform; it can liberate and renew, or shock and destabilize when reform breaks down.
Uranus.mundane: The individual against the mass: democracy, countercultures, revolution — and the machines that run without us: factories, computers, the internet (Mercury rules tools needing human skill; Uranus rules automation). Dignified: constructive reform and national success. Debilitated: crises, failed reforms, shocking events that seize the imagination.

Neptune.actor: mass movements, propaganda, the collective mood
Neptune.summary: To Dissolve & Idealize · Mass movements, propaganda, and collective mood. Unity, sea and oil, bubbles, scandal, and glamour; mundane Neptune is shadow-heavy and should be treated cautiously unless completely unafflicted.
Neptune.mundane: Almost always malefic in a mundane chart — the hardest-won rule in the toolkit. Neptune is unity, from the divine to the mob, and politics is rarely kind to unities: mass movements, propaganda, speculative bubbles, scandal, dissolution. Only completely unafflicted does he favor democracy and peace. Sun–Neptune hostile is the single most dangerous aspect in mundane work. Debilitated in the 6th or 8th: pandemic warning.

Pluto.summary: To Transform & Purge · Masses-as-force and collective power. Purgation, coercive transformation, destruction, and rebirth; keep the reading tied to actual evidence because Pluto invites projection more readily than any other planet.
Pluto.mundane: Collective power as raw force — purgation, destruction-and-rebirth, the compulsive imposition of mass will. Handle with healthy skepticism: Pluto invites projection more than any other planet, and many predicted catastrophes never came; keep him in the chart but stay grounded in actual data. In this chronicle he carries the Aquarius signature: the underworld struggle over what the new human being will be.

Earth.summary: Our observing seat. In geocentric astrology Earth is the vantage point, so it has no sign, house, or aspects of its own.
Earth.mundane: The Orrery keeps Earth visible as the body from which the apparent zodiacal sky is read; it is not a separate mundane actor.
